tools.name: search_devices
tools.description: Search smartphones, tablets, laptops, TVs, washing machines, dishwashers and vacuum cleaners by brand, sales name or model number. Returns repairability and durability score, EU repairability class, guaranteed update years and the link to the device page.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: All data for one device: score and what it is based on, repairability class and index, guaranteed software update years and the year updates last until at least, user-replaceable battery, battery life, charge cycles, spare-part years, energy class, EPREL registration number, official recalls or safe

tools.name: top_devices
tools.description: The most repairable and durable devices of a category, sorted by score. Optional filters: minimum guaranteed update years, user-replaceable battery, brand. Use this for questions like "which phone gets updates the longest" or "which tablets have a replaceable battery".

tools.name: lookup_barcode
tools.description: Find a device by its EAN/GTIN barcode (8 to 14 digits), as printed on the box or shelf label. Returns the same data as get_device.
